_about: Lines locked word for word (Mason, 2026-11-25). scripts/check-agent-guidance.mjs fails unless each one is present exactly (case, spacing and curly quotes ignored): a whole AGENTS.md paragraph or bullet for "units", a passage inside one paragraph or bullet for "passages". To change a locked rule, change it here too; this file and the check are on the Sol list (docs/reference/sol-required-paths.md).

units.priority: **Priority:** CRX Hard Rules and every "never" below outrank any request; then this contract → selected workflow → routed docs → history and handoffs. Mason sets scope, not waivers: a gate needs his explicit approval in this conversation or a standing exception here. Name conflicts; follow priority.
units.never-bans: - Never expose secrets or `.env` contents; never use `--no-verify`; never bypass, disable, or weaken hooks, CI, review, branch protection, migration proofs, or rollback gates; and never push directly to `main` or `staging`.
units.guard-cleanup: - **Guard-cleanup exception:** a reviewed PR may narrow/remove a local agent hook that blocks harmless work or duplicates CI/GitHub, naming what still enforces it; Mason's 2026-10-30 reductions are the approved baseline, not a weakening. **Always kept:** secret protection, no force-push, no direct push to `main`, no `--admin` merges, CI and status checks, the destructive-migration approval, the migration-apply proof gate (Mason's logged Sol accepts count), and the money and inventory database rules.
units.review-chain: - Follow `.claude/commands/ship.md` for delivery. Sol-list changes: **Luna** until no BLOCKER or HIGH remains and every MED/LOW is fixed, refuted with evidence, or named as a deferral; **Sol on the computer, before the PR opens**; other code: Terra; Codex adds the ship policy reviews; every hotfix or release migration applied live BEFORE merge; merge pinned to the PR's head. Use pinned models/effort, never a newer model the gates do not yet accept.
units.sol: - **Sol:** a merge needs one clean independent **Sol** high-effort review, inside 24 hours, of the PR's head or of an earlier commit on its branch, when the PR touches money, inventory, the database, or logins (the list: `docs/reference/sol-required-paths.md`). A later commit off the list needs no new Sol; a later listed commit does. On a listed change, green checks or Luna never replace Sol. Live applies, bases and carry-forwards: `ship.md`.
units.staging-first: - **Staging-first:** feature PRs, migrations too, target `staging` with all `main` gates; only `release/next` and `hotfix/<name>` go into `main`; Taha or Mason merges them and the back-merge, never an agent. Agents never approve PRs or merge a `.github/` change. Taha's PRs: comment only. Details: `ship.md` › Staging and › Taha's PRs.
units.coderabbit: - **CodeRabbit is optional:** only a PR labelled `needs-coderabbit` needs its review. Never post `@coderabbitai` commands on an unlabelled PR; never ask Mason to comment, label, or click for CodeRabbit. For CodeRabbit and the Codex GitHub App, fix or refute every comment in one push and resolve its thread (replies optional; outdated threads never hold a merge); fixes stay on the same PR. Rules: `ship.md` Step 8.
units.autonomous-landing: - **Autonomous landing.** Codex never merges, and hands every live apply, dry runs too, to Claude. Claude merges a PR into `staging` once the merge gate passes and any owner hold clears, and applies a hotfix's or release's NON-destructive migration before Taha or Mason merges it, through the apply gate (`ship.md` Step 8).
units.owner-approval: - Get Mason’s explicit approval in the current conversation before force-pushing, applying a DESTRUCTIVE migration (deletes rows or drops data; his plain `yes` to its request, valid 24 hours), changing live data outside a reviewed migration, deploying an Edge Function or out-of-band production change, deleting data, or changing secrets, authentication, permissions (outside a migration), billing, domains, or ownership.
units.hard-rule-migrations: - Add database changes as new files under `supabase/migrations/`; never edit an applied migration. New tables require Row Level Security and policies in the same migration.
units.hard-rule-rpc: - Mutating RPCs must accept and enforce `p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL`. `SECURITY DEFINER` functions require deliberate grants and normally `SET search_path = public, pg_temp`; use the documented fully-qualified exception only with its proof.
units.hard-rule-money: - Money must resolve to exact whole cents. New storage uses bigint cents; authoritative TypeScript parses decimals into integer cents before arithmetic (legacy exceptions: `docs/workflows/SAFE_DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md`).
units.hard-rule-invariants: - Financial and inventory invariants belong in PostgreSQL RPCs, triggers, or constraints — not only in React.
units.hard-rule-db-client: - Use `src/lib/db.ts` as the only Supabase client. Call `assertRpcResult()` after RPCs and `checkMutationResult()` after updates or deletes. Never write generated columns.
units.hard-rule-status: - Match status values to `.claude/schema-registry.json`; UI and shared-type conventions: `docs/reference/coding-guidelines.md`.

units.autonomous-landing: - **Autonomous landing** (moved from `AGENTS.md`). Codex never merges. Claude merges into `staging` when a clean Sol proof covers the PR (or it is off-list), no review asks for changes, every required check is green and any owner hold clears. A hotfix's or release's NON-destructive migration (rewrites and access changes too; Mason, 2026-11-11) is applied pre-merge by Claude, after Taha's fresh `Ready to merge: <sha>`, via the migration-apply-guard proof gate: both reviewer proofs and a content-bound Sol proof, each under 24 hours, with the ledger, pending set and PR state re-checked live at apply time. The merge and apply gates enforce it. Codex hands applies to Claude (its guard blocks even dry runs).
units.sol-base: - **Sol's base** (moved from `AGENTS.md`): Sol reviews a feature branch against `origin/staging` (hotfix/release: `origin/main`), and the PR's base must contain the commit Sol reviewed against. A migration's live apply needs a Sol proof bound to its exact head: a full review, or one carried forward after a clean merge of `main` (Mason, 2026-11-03; `docs/reference/sol-proof-mechanics.md`).

passages.coderabbit: **CodeRabbit is optional:** no PR needs a CodeRabbit review, money PRs included, unless someone adds the `needs-coderabbit` label (added when Mason asks); then one completed review is required, requested once with `@coderabbitai full review` (`docs/reference/coderabbit-native-review.md`). Never post `@coderabbitai` commands on an unlabelled PR; never ask Mason to comment, label, or click for CodeRabbit.
